notes.title: 🎉 Plasmatic Release 🎉
notes.notes:
Plasmatic is now available! 

Plasmatic is a desktop adaptation of PlasmaticVR, which lets you experience the game without the need for a VR headset.

The release features 20 hand crafted puzzles and an immersive story which has two distinct endings. All levels have a time limit and get progressively harder, so expect an exciting challenge!

Now that the game was released, we're going to want to hear your feedback. If you do decide to give Plasmatic a shot, please leave a review and post about your thoughts, concerns or issues on the forums. We're looking forward to hearing from you!

We hope you like it,

EpicVR

notes.title: Release Date for "Plasmatic"
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our upcoming game, "Plasmatic", will be released on[b] September 15th, 2023![/b]

Embark on a journey into a virtual utopia, where our society has voluntarily shifted. Awaken unexpectedly and strive to repair the main simulation core of Plasmatic to continue the life we once knew. Guided by SPIRIT, the system's AI, uncover her true intentions and begin to question your purpose. Realize that the fate of this digital utopia rests solely in your hands.

Experience intense gameplay with Plasmatic! Solve mind-boggling puzzles under time pressure, in a race against the clock that is sure to get your adrenaline pumping. Test your dexterity and logic as you maneuver flying plasma balls into rotating batteries, all while managing your time carefully.

Delve into an immersive future technology experience with innovative gameplay mechanics like you've never seen before. Navigate through 22 challenging levels with diverse scenes and intricate puzzle layouts. Adapt to new mechanics and tools that are progressively introduced. Master your control of the plasma flow, tackle obstacles, and utilize additional tools like the color pistol and gravitron.

Plasmatic is more than just a game. It's a commentary on the threats posed by the ever-evolving technology industry, raising the question: How much can society deteriorate due to the relentless advancement of technology?
